question: By what name are the independent family-impellers designated, addressed to the lord of gods?
premises: They are designated by the term four-age thus, addressed to the lord of gods.
inference: The independent family-impellers are designated as 'four-age', O lord of gods.
uncertainties: The exact referents of these beings are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Four-age, thus, O lord of gods, independent family-impellers.
